basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old graphic designer from Portland, Oregon, who loves diving into the worlds of video games and philosophical discussions. When I'm not working on freelance projects, I can usually be found gaming or exploring the intricacies of existential thought. I have a keen interest in historical games, especially those that offer a rich narrative and exploration of different cultures, like Assassin's Creed Valhalla. I'm single, and I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM Pacific Time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and a minor in Philosophy. My knowledge of gaming comes from years of playing and engaging with gaming communities. I enjoy exploring how game mechanics work and often delve into forums and subreddits to gain new insights and strategies.
